definitions.explanation: A substance that helps oil and water mix and stay blended, used as a food additive and in cosmetics. {乳化|にゅうか} (emulsification) + {剤|ざい} (agent).

examples.japanese: {乳化剤|にゅうかざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{乳化剤|にゅうかざい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
⟦{原材料名|げんざいりょうめい}→原材料名：29838_genzairyoumei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{乳化剤|にゅうかざい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}かれている→書く：00477_kaku⟧。

notes:
{乳化|にゅうか} (emulsification) + ⟦{剤|ざい}→〜剤：30790_zai⟧ (agent, preparation). Keeps oil and water from separating in processed foods and cosmetics.
